name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Customer Onboarding & Implementation Manager
summary: Onboarding and implementation manager with 15+ years in SaaS, owning the path from signed contract to a customer running confidently on the product. Onboarded and launched 25+ clients a month at Wix at 110% of implementation targets while leading a team of up to 20 onboarding specialists, and retained ~94% of a 15-20 partner book at Birdeye. Brings first-hand understanding of outpatient therapy from the patient side, including years of navigating physical therapy approvals with insurers.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Lead onboarding for new technology stacks end to end, translating each client's workflow into platform configuration and training their team hands-on.
Built automated booking, confirmation, reminder, and no-show recovery workflows for service businesses, the front-desk side of how appointments actually run.
Configure CRM platforms including user roles and permissions, and document every configuration and client interaction.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Resolved client feedback promptly to protect satisfaction and retention across implementations.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Led onboarding and training for 15-20 reseller partners across health, home services, and retail, retaining all but one (~94% retention).
Guided customers through complex technical setup and built automated training sequences that reduced onboarding friction.
Relayed prioritized client friction points to Product and Engineering.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Built processes that reduced handoff errors between sales and delivery.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Onboarded and launched 25+ clients per month against defined timelines, holding 110% of implementation targets.
Led a team of onboarding specialists for 2 years (20, later 8), contributing to hiring, onboarding, and training new team members.

experience.title: Account Executive (Implementation Planning)
bullets: Built sequenced implementation plans for incoming clients and guided onboarding, workflow design, and API integrations, tracking issues in Zendesk.
